lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11-12 distinct white vertical lines are visible across the lateral torso; spacing is widest in the central region and compresses significantly towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the fourth line from the posterior; a secondary merging of two segments occurs at the dorsal midline above the shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple dashed segments are present, notably the second and fifth lines from the posterior, which terminate mid-torso and do not reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, with a secondary grouping of 2 spots on the lower hind limb near the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align to form a semi-connected diagonal line oriented at roughly 45 degrees towards the tail base.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white spot markings are visible on the cheek and a white chevron-like band is present between the eyes; a white patch is visible on the ventral side of the tail.
